title: Drawing-reader questions
description: reader-questions.json in the work folder (tool wave 3): the questions the drawing-reader agent raised with `harness ask` (producer `reader` in question-registry.json). It is an intake-schema 'questions' document (every rule of intake.schema.json applies, so `harness validate intake` still accepts it) with the reader's own constraints: one question per code, blocking flag, file and where, so each question has exactly one ref and count 1; a reader question is never closed by another answer (no closed_by) and lists no subjects. `places` and `amendments` (harness ask --amend) appear only here. Check a file with `harness validate reader-questions <work>/reader-questions.json`.
